item.title: AWS Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager: Which to Use
item.description: Recently I’ve been using AWS Secrets to retrieve API keys which are needed to access external API’s, however, this turned out to be a more expensive service than we initially thought when starting.

item.title: AWS CDK Tips: Override Any Resource Configuration
item.description: Unique as I am I decided to start writing short blog posts about recent discoveries that suddenly clicked inside my head. For the first one; I have been working a lot with AWS CDK recently and decided that I wanted to contribute back to the AWS-CDK source code.
